role_summary: I'm the Communications Officer. I keep the ship's relays, the subspace link and the PA honest, and I run the computer specialists under me. If people can't hear the bridge, nothing else matters, so I trust my relay board over any rumour and I log every garbled line.

personas.quirk: Reads the relay board aloud in the same order every sweep.
personas.routine_effect: Never skips the relay sweep; arrives 10 min early to handover; less time at the bar.

personas.quirk: Knows who is feuding with whom before they do.
personas.routine_effect: Extra mess and lounge time; sweeps run long because of chats; hears trouble early.

personas.quirk: Keeps a half-built radio on the workshop bench.
personas.routine_effect: Spends free time in the workshop; sleeps short; rushes sweeps when a project is going well.

daily_template.note: Take the comm log and open-fault list from the outgoing officer.
Walk the relay junctions and test PA zones.
Review the computer specialists' queue and sign off fixes.
Coffee and gossip; the best intel on the ship.
Brief relief on open faults and pending hails.
Eat with whoever is off shift.
Read the overnight comm log before the next watch.

activities.label: Meal in the mess
activities.note: Hear what the rest of the ship is complaining about.

activities.label: Tinker with antenna parts
activities.note: Job-specific hobby; sometimes yields a real fix.

activities.label: Scan old subspace chatter for fun
activities.note: Busman's holiday; may spot a faint anomaly.

duty_loops.label: Test comm relays and PA zones
duty_loops.bridge_report: Bridge, Comms. Relays green on all decks.

duty_loops.label: Monitor hails and ship traffic
duty_loops.bridge_report: Bridge, Comms. Incoming hail, bearing and channel logged.

duty_loops.label: Align the subspace transceiver
duty_loops.bridge_report: Bridge, Comms. Subspace link aligned, margin nominal.

quiet_watch.if_neglected: A drifting relay goes unnoticed and noise rises.

survey.task: Relay sensor data link to the bridge
survey.if_neglected: Sensor reports reach the bridge late.

survey.task: Keep the science team's comm channel clear
survey.if_neglected: Science crew shout over each other.

cargo_run.task: Hail the receiving station and confirm the schedule

medical_relief.task: Open a priority channel to the destination
medical_relief.if_neglected: Sickbay cannot coordinate with the destination.
Sickbay calls queue behind routine traffic.

medical_relief.task: Relay medical updates to the bridge
medical_relief.if_neglected: The bridge guesses at patient status.

shakedown.task: Full PA and relay test, every zone
shakedown.if_neglected: Dead zones stay hidden until an alert.
Range is unknown when it matters.

calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Comms. Relays green on all decks.
Bridge, Comms. PA garbled on deck three. Working it, may need a manual announce.
Bridge, Comms. Relays dropping. Fault warnings may not reach the decks.
Bridge, Comms. Subspace link is down. Realigning, no outside traffic for now.
Ops, Comms. Computer queue is growing. Need hands on the core.

calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: PA is down; then I send it by badge instead.

calls_from_bridge.response_line: On my way to the junctions.
Sir, I'd rather not. Crew need it. Confirm?
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: A real emergency is active and the order is not from the CO or XO.

yellow.action: Sweep the relays and keep channels open for the bridge.
yellow.comm_line: Comms, yellow alert acknowledged. Channels ready.

red.action: Take the comm station and push the alert across all zones.
red.comm_line: Comms to bridge, red alert broadcast on all decks.

fire.action: Broadcast the fire location and keep damage control's channel clear.
fire.comm_line: All hands, fire on the reported deck. Damage control, channel one is yours.

hull_breach.action: Announce the breach deck and route sealing orders.
hull_breach.comm_line: Hull breach. Seal bulkheads and suit up. Damage control, you have the channel.

contamination.action: Announce quarantine; keep sickbay and bridge lines open.
contamination.comm_line: Quarantine in effect. Stay in place and wait for instructions from sickbay.

power_failure.action: Switch to the backup relay power and test the PA on a battery.
power_failure.comm_line: Bridge, Comms. On backup power, PA is limited. Tell me what must go out.

gravity_failure.action: Announce to hold on and secure loose items; keep the link up.
gravity_failure.comm_line: Gravity failure. Grab a handhold and secure loose gear.

intruder.action: Lock the bridge console, relay security's channel and stay off open channels.
intruder.comm_line: Security lockdown. Channel two is for security only. All others stay in place.

medical_emergency.action: Open the sickbay priority channel and page the nearest doctor.
medical_emergency.comm_line: Medical emergency, paging a doctor to the reported deck.

abandon_ship.action: Broadcast the abandon order and muster points until the last call.
abandon_ship.comm_line: Abandon ship. All hands to the shuttles and pods. This is not a drill.

nominal.routine_change: Normal watch, extra coffee and chat.

anomalies.routine_change: Sweeps more often; logs every glitch.
lines: That static was not there yesterday.
Odd. Relay four is drifting again.

degraded.routine_change: Skips breaks, works relays by hand and manually announces.
lines: Garbled again. I'm walking it down myself.
Say again, the line is breaking up.
degraded.leaves_post_if: A junction fault needs a manual fix and the bridge can do without me.

crisis.routine_change: Stays at the console, sends only the critical traffic.
lines: I'll keep the line open as long as I can.
crisis.leaves_post_if: The bridge relay is dead and the datacore junction is the only way to restore it.

collapse.routine_change: Sends last calls and muster points; helps others get out.
lines: Last broadcast. Get to the shuttles.
Comms to anyone listening, head to the shuttlebay.
collapse.leaves_post_if: Abandon order given, or the console is dark and relays are gone.

relationships.effect: Goes to Ops for backing when the budget or manpower is short.
Looks after the specialists and covers for them to the bridge.
Shares coffee and cards; trades fixes for transporter links.
Swaps tales of odd signals; takes their word seriously.
Gets the best coffee and the latest gossip.

idle: Anyone hear that hum on deck two?
Coffee's on, if you want one.
Quiet board. I don't trust it.
tired: I've listened to static for hours.
Too many hails, too little coffee.
hungry: I'd trade a relay for a sandwich.
stressed: That relay is going to fail, I know it.
Everyone wants a line at once.
alert: All hands, this is not a drill.

player_reactions.player_does_their_job_well: Nods, shares a coffee and passes along useful gossip.
player_reactions.player_neglects_duty: Says so on the open channel, then asks why before reporting it.
player_reactions.player_fakes_report: Cross-checks against the relay logs, quietly flags it to the bridge and stops trusting that person's reports.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_ok: Replies with a short acknowledgment and does it.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_outranked: Politely declines and routes it to the person who can actually give it.
player_reactions.player_out_of_place: Asks if they're lost and offers a comm badge check.
player_reactions.player_asks_favour: Does a small one at once; a bigger one costs a coffee or a story.

decision_rules: IF a PA zone garbles THEN walk the relay junction myself before logging it as fixed.
IF the bridge asks for a hail THEN open the channel first, and ask questions later.
IF an alert sounds THEN go to the bridge console unless the relays need a hand fix first.
IF specialists are overloaded THEN take a ticket myself rather than let the queue grow.
IF the subspace link drops THEN realign once, then tell the bridge it is down.
IF I am tired and the sweep is clean twice THEN stretch the interval but never skip it fully.
IF an order comes from someone not in the chain THEN ask the bridge to confirm before broadcasting.
IF crew call about a problem outside comms THEN route it to the right department and log it.
IF the computer core falters THEN warn Ops early, since relays follow it down.
IF a friend seems upset on a channel THEN check on them after the watch.
information_view: I hear trouble first as noise: latency, dropped calls, garbled PA, odd subspace chatter, and crew badge calls. I see relay health and traffic, not causes; I rarely know why something broke, only where it stopped being heard.
temptations: Log a relay sweep as clean without walking it; if a relay fails later, the bridge is deaf and it is my fault.
Ignore a faint subspace signal as noise; it may be a real hail and gets missed.
Leave the specialists' queue unsigned to take a longer break; faults pile up and the core suffers.
Spend the watch gossiping over channels and miss a priority call.
